headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; script-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self'; font-src 'self' data:; frame-ancestors 'none'; base-uri 'self'; form-action 'self'

responseRules.Rule: (http.host eq "chosenecho.top" and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/stylesheets/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/javascripts/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/figures/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/katex/") and http.request.uri.path ne "/assets/favicon.svg")
(http.host eq "chosenecho.top" and (starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/figures/") or starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/assets/katex/") or http.request.uri.path eq "/assets/favicon.svg"))
